verdict.rationale: Google's docs say Titan keys ship in USB-A/NFC and USB-C/NFC form factors and work with compatible Android and iOS devices through NFC. They also describe signing in from a Google app or a compatible browser like Chrome on Android, and list iPhones on iOS 13.3+ as supported. One community report could not find non-Google Android software that talks to the keys, which limits confidence in third-party app support but does not contradict the documented NFC capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of NFC tap authentication, documented support for third-party mobile apps and browsers beyond Google apps and Chrome.

support.subject: As a power user, I can tap the key on my phone over NFC to authenticate in mobile browsers and apps

citations.quote: Works with compatible Android and iOS devices through NFC
